what: Verify-gate budget measurement. Unlike gap-audit and spec this gate cannot be swept from documents - it needs a real diff, criteria, and evidence - so it was run through `sasu gate verify --contract` against this repository own judge work.
diff: e9a09f7..HEAD, the judge-budget changes themselves, --skip-mechanical so only judge wall time is measured

trueContract.note: 8 criteria, all satisfied by the diff

minedContract.note: same 8 plus 3 deliberately false criteria (AC9 claims the shipped default is high, AC10 claims the api backend sends cache_control, AC11 claims runVerifyGate reads laneEffort - none are true)

xhigh.note: not completed - the run exceeded a 10 minute measurement window

conclusion: medium is sufficient for verify: it caught every planted false criterion with zero false positives, at 76% of high wall time on the mined contract and 52% on the true one. The shape differs from the other two gates because the question does: gap-audit and spec are open searches where budget buys coverage, while verify asks whether a diff satisfies a stated criterion - the answer is in the diff, so extra reasoning has nothing further to find.
caveat: One contract, one run per budget, and the xhigh arm is missing. This is the weakest of the three gate measurements; re-measure with repeats before treating verify=medium as firmly as gap-audit=high and spec=high.
